timing: Created after the definitive Cosmos short-paraphrase left arm (10 episodes) and right seed 6100 completed, before the remaining confirmation grid and before any prospective result was compiled.
trigger: An integrity comparison found that byte-identical simulator initial-state arrays do not imply byte-identical realtime-rendered policy observations across environment resets.
likely_scope: Realtime renderer and temporal denoiser/reset variation plus millimeter-scale object settling before the first recorded action. Robot joints, gripper state, rigid-object reset state, camera calibration, task geometry, and physical GPU assignment are unchanged.

decision.first_chunk_action_contrast: downgraded from a causal prompt-versus-sampling estimate to a sensitivity diagnostic containing both prompt and renderer variation
decision.fixed_observation_command_probe: remains the only exact image-and-seed prompt intervention
decision.reporting_language: Closed-loop episodes are matched on exact reset state and renderer configuration, not byte-identical first-observed physical state or pixels. Same-prompt variation includes sampling, millimeter-scale settling, and renderer variation. Opposite-prompt first-chunk separation includes the same nuisance variation.

continuation_reason: Restarting with a different renderer after observing these results would introduce a new post-outcome setup choice and discard ten valid primary-outcome episodes. The complete definitive grid therefore retains one physical GPU assignment and renderer configuration, measures observation variation where inputs are recorded, and narrows the secondary action-contrast claim.
required_follow_up: Compile pairwise first-conditioning-image MAE for every definitive Cosmos static condition.
Compile first-recorded cube/bowl centroid distances within conditions and for every matched pair.
Report matched left/right image MAE and within-direction image MAE beside action contrast.
Do not call the closed-loop action ratio a pure language effect or pure sampling-noise ratio.
Preserve the hash-pinned fixed-observation probe as the causal language-sensitivity test.
claim_boundary: Exact reset-state matching supports outcome comparison but does not isolate language from millimeter-scale settling and stochastic renderer pixels in the closed-loop first action. Only the frozen fixed-observation probe isolates the prompt at identical input bytes.
